tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Rank the price of one subscription plan (e.g. ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, Google AI Pro) across countries and regions, converted to one currency. Answers questions like "where is ChatGPT Plus cheapest?" or "how much is Claude Pro in Turkey?". Prices are monthly equivalents; for yearly billing the full

tools.name: get_region_prices
tools.description: Show every plan price of one product in one country or region, for each sales channel and billing interval, with its rank among all regions and its difference from the United States. Answers questions like "how much does ChatGPT cost in Japan?" or "is Claude cheaper in India than in the US?".

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: List the recorded price changes of one plan in one region, newest first, with the previous and new local price. Use it for questions like "has ChatGPT Plus gotten more expensive in Brazil?".

tools.name: get_recent_price_changes
tools.description: List monthly subscription price changes AISub recorded across all regions in the last N days, newest first. Use it for questions like "which countries changed ChatGPT prices this month?".

tools.name: compare_credits
tools.description: Compare credit pack prices (extra usage credits sold on top of a subscription, such as ChatGPT credits) across regions, normalised to the price per 100 credits in one currency. Answers questions like "where are ChatGPT credits cheapest?".
